incidents.reference_summary: AWS CloudWatch raised a warning for increased 4xx client errors on the EMEA production Place-Search translations/public endpoint, indicating client request issues or recent config/deploy changes may be causing validation, authorization, or routing failures. Impact currently noted for Location Services (global).
reference_mitigation_suggestions: Break down 4xx errors by status code and route to pinpoint the source: analyze CloudWatch metrics and access logs for translations/public, segment by 400/401/403/404/429, and identify top offending clients, user agents, and paths.
incidents.notes: Automated incident for EMEA Place-Search 4xx errors

incidents.reference_summary: Customer’s ID7/HU_MGU navigation shows German gas stations without prices when searching along the route near 49.20378, 8.59601 on 2026-08-29, while fuel prices display normally for France and Spain, indicating a Germany-specific fuel price data or entitlement issue rather than connectivity or hardware.
reference_mitigation_suggestions: Verify the DE fuel price provider/feed status (EMEA PROD) around 2026-08-29 13:34 UTC; check backend health dashboards and logs for Germany-only fuel price services (e.g., TPEG/POI price feed) to confirm a regional data outage or suppression.
incidents.notes: Manual incident for DE fuel price issue
